components.name: RSA1_5 (RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport — the library's DEFAULT JWE algorithm)
components.bom-ref: pqs:finding:lib/json/jwt.rb:44:RSA1_5 (RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 key transport — the library's DEFAULT JWE algorithm)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 cache-key derivation in the shipped JWKS fetcher (fetcher.rb:63-68): OpenSSL::Digest::MD5.hexdigest(jwks_uri) builds the cache namespace 'json:jwk:set:<md5>:<kid>'. Non-security purpose (cache key), but MD5 collisions could cross-wire cached JWKS between URIs — a keyset-confusion vector, not a confidentiality break. Spec sites mirror the same cache-key scheme. Migration: SHA-256.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Spec-only TLS posture control: fetcher_spec disables certificate verification on the JWKS fetcher's Faraday client (config.ssl.verify = false) so stubbed test endpoints work. The shipped library never sets ssl.verify — Faraday/net-http defaults (verification on) apply in production. Recorded as test infrastructure posture, not a production control.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ES256K support in the shipped library: JWK crv 'secp256k1' mapping (jwk.rb:137-138), JWKizable reverse mapping (jwkizable.rb:47-48), JWS algorithm autodetection for secp256k1 keys (jws.rb:81) and ECDSA group validation (jws.rb:151-152); spec sites sign/verify on secp256k1. Shor-vulnerable curve exposed to all gem consumers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-OAEP key transport in JWE (the library's strongest RSA encryption path): encrypt via public_encrypt with PKCS1_OAEP_PADDING (jwe.rb:175-176), decrypt via private_decrypt (jwe.rb:227-228); interop specs interoperate with Nimbus JOSE using RSA-OAEP. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor) RSA encryption; migrate to ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC content encryption in JWE: 'aes-128-cbc' for A128CBC-HS256 and 'aes-256-cbc' for A256CBC-HS512 (jwe.rb:135-137). Note: in JWE these modes are authenticated by the separate HMAC-SHA256/512 tag (RFC 7518), so the JWE as a whole is not unauthenticated. The pem site is the DEK-Info header of the committed test RSA key — traditional OpenSSL PEM encryption (AES-256-CBC).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA key material handling: JWK→PKey conversion that reconstructs a full RSA private key from n,e,d,p,q,dp,dq,qi (jwk.rb:98-126), feeding every RS/PS/RSA1_5/RSA-OAEP path; spec helper loads the committed fixture private key with hardcoded passphrase 'pass-phrase' (sign_key_fixture_helper.rb:27-30, 48-52).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test fixture: mock JWKS endpoint response declaring RS256 JWKs, used by the JWKS fetcher and signature-verification specs. Fixture data, but a genuine algorithm declaration in the repo's test infrastructure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Spec assertions that HMAC-signed JWTs carry alg HS256; the library's actual HMAC-SHA256 implementation is OpenSSL::HMAC.digest at lib/json/jws.rb:105 (filed as a separate finding since no roster object covers the lib call chain).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed RSA private key fixture (PKCS#1 PEM, passphrase-protected, DEK-Info AES-256-CBC) used by specs; README.md site is the same key shown as documentation example. Test material, but real committed key material in the repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed RSA-2048 public key fixture (PKCS#1 SPKI), the public half of the private_key.pem used by specs.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed RSA private key in DER/ASN.1 form used by specs to test DER key loading (sign_key_fixture_helper.rb der_file_path).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA implementation in the shipped library: sign path private_key.sign(digest, signature_base_string) with raw↔ASN.1 signature conversion (jws.rb:112-118, 165-175), verify path public_key.verify with raw_to_asn1 (jws.rb:136-139), curve/algebra group enforcement via throwaway OpenSSL::PKey::EC.generate (jws.rb:147-163) across P-256/P-384/P-521/secp256k1 (ES256/ES384/ES512/ES256K). Spec sites exercise all four variants including interop with jsrsasign. Shor-vulnerable; migrate to ML-DSA-65/SLH-DS

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (prime256v1) support: JWK crv 'P-256'→'prime256v1' mapping (jwk.rb:132), reverse mapping in JWKizable (jwkizable.rb:41), ES256 autodetection (jws.rb:75), ECDSA group validation default (jws.rb:154); specs sign/verify ES256 on prime256v1. Shor-vulnerable curve; migration path ML-DSA for signatures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384/P-521 (secp384r1/secp521r1) support: JWK crv mappings (jwk.rb:133-136), JWKizable reverse mappings (jwkizable.rb:43-46), ES384/ES512 autodetection (jws.rb:77-79), group validation (jws.rb:157-159); specs exercise both curves. Shor-vulnerable curves; migrate signatures to ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 digests constructed in specs (x5t/thumbprint tests at jwt_spec.rb:297, 325). Library-side SHA-256 use exists too and is filed separately: JWK thumbprint default digest (jwk.rb:28) and the JWS SHA-2 digest factory (jws.rb:47).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 content encryption in JWE: 'aes-128-gcm' for A128GCM and 'aes-128-cbc' for A128CBC-HS256, selected in cipher_name (jwe.rb:130-135) and instantiated via OpenSSL::Cipher.new (jwe.rb:123-126). PQ note: 128-bit key gives only 64-bit Grover-bound security.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM AEAD content encryption in JWE: A128GCM/A256GCM map to aes-128-gcm/aes-256-gcm (jwe.rb:130-133), with GCM auth_data/auth_tag handling in encrypt!/decrypt! (jwe.rb:35-38, 54-59). PQ-safe symmetric AEAD (Grover only halves strength).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-512 digest constructed in spec (jwt_spec.rb:361, x5t/thumbprint test). Library-side SHA-384/SHA-512 arrive dynamically via "SHA#{alg.to_s[2,3]}" / "SHA#{sha_size}" and are filed as separate findings at jws.rb:47 and jwe.rb:155.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 usage: 'aes-256-gcm' for A256GCM and 'aes-256-cbc' for A256CBC-HS512 in the JWE cipher map (jwe.rb:133, 137); third site is the DEK-Info AES-256-CBC envelope of the committed test RSA private key (traditional OpenSSL PEM encryption). 256-bit keys retain 128-bit Grover-bound security.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SecureRandom (CSPRNG) key/IV material: library-side CEK generation for JWE CBC modes (jwe.rb:199 — 32/64-byte CEK), GCM CEK via cipher.random_key (jwe.rb:197, OpenSSL RNG); spec sites generate test shared keys/CEKs. Adequate randomness source for keygen.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SPKI public key embedded in README.md as a usage example; documentation key material.
